notes: Verified against the UCSD General Catalog (catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/ETHN-ug.html). Major = 2 lower-division + 13 upper-division four-unit courses = 15 courses total (~60 units). CORRECTION: harvested notes said ~52 units, which is wrong math; 15 x 4 = 60 units. All courses must be completed with a grade of P, C-, or better. Students may take up to two courses (lower or upper division) Pass/Not Pass, excluding independent study (ETHN 197/198/199, which are always P/NP). Majors may petition up to three upper-division courses from other UCSD departments or approved study abroad to fulfill major requirements. The department's own /undergraduate/major page returned HTTP 404, so structure is sourced from the General Catalog.

buckets.label: Lower-division introductory courses (choose 2 of 3)
buckets.note: Two lower-division courses from ETHN 1-2-3. ETHN 1 (Land and Labor), ETHN 2 (Circulations of Difference), ETHN 3 (Making Culture). Ideally completed by sophomore year. Verified on catalog page.

buckets.label: Upper-division required core
buckets.note: All three required: 100A Theoretical Approaches, 100B Interdisciplinary Methodologies, 100C Social Justice Praxis. 4 units each. Verified on catalog page.

buckets.label: Upper-division Ethnic Studies electives
buckets.note: Ten four-unit upper-division ETHN elective courses selected from the department's approved list. Up to three may be petitioned as cross-listed upper-division courses from other UCSD departments or approved study abroad. Range 'ETHN 100-199' is a placeholder for the approved upper-division elective list, not a single course. Verified on catalog page.
